task.prompt: 实现 Python 函数 process_idempotent_transfers(initial_balances, events)。initial_balances 是账户名到非负整数余额的字典。每个 event 必须且只能包含 id、from、to、amount：前三者为非空字符串，from 与 to 不同，amount 为正整数。首次出现的 id：若来源余额不足，状态为 rejected 且不改变余额；否则执行转账，必要时创建目标账户，状态为 applied。每个结果为 {id, status, from_balance, to_balance}，余额字段是该事件首次处理后的两个账户余额。重复 id 且载荷完全相同必须返回首次缓存的结果，绝不能再次执行，即使余额后来发生变化；重复 id 但 from/to/amount 任一不同必须抛出 ValueError。返回 {results: 按输入事件顺序的结果列表, balances: 最终余额字典}。缺失来源账户按余额 0 处理。非法初始余额、非法事件、冲突幂等键均抛出 ValueError。不得修改输入或使用全局状态。

test_cases.description: duplicate applied event returns cached result without reapplying
missing source has zero balance and rejection creates no accounts
successful transfer creates a missing destination
empty event list returns an independent balance copy
same id with a conflicting destination is rejected
identical duplicate is replayed from cache
cached rejection remains rejected after later funding
same id with different payload is a contract violation
